en.t: The full text of the saibara song "My Little Sister and I" is: "

units.source_text: 小妹与我入山中，切莫手触辛夷丛！

en.t: My little sister and I go into the mountains; do not touch the magnolia thickets with your hands!

units.source_text: 只恐衣香移将去，使得辛夷香更浓。”

en.t: I only fear that the fragrance of our robes will pass to them, making the magnolias smell even richer."
